paragraphs: We are engaged in the design, construction and sale of new homes in markets in Texas, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, New Mexico, Colorado, North Carolina, South Carolina, Washington, Tennessee, Minnesota, Oklahoma, Alabama, California, Oregon, Nevada, West Virginia, Virginia, Pennsylvania, Maryland and Utah. Our management team has been in the residential land development business since the mid-1990s. Since commencing home building operations in 2003, we have constructed and closed over 80,000 homes.

LGI Homes, Inc. is a Delaware corporation incorporated on July 9, 2013. Our principal executive offices are located at 1450 Lake Robbins Drive, Suite 430, The Woodlands, Texas 77380, and our telephone number is (281) 362-8998. Information on or linked to our website is not incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K unless expressly noted.
Unless otherwise indicated or the context requires, "LGI," the "Company," "we," "our" and "us" refer collectively to LGI Homes, Inc. and its subsidiaries.

Since December 2013, we have grown substantially, expanding our operations from eight markets in four states to 36 markets in 21 states. As of December 31, 2025, we were active in 144 communities throughout the United States and expect to continue increasing our community count in the future.

Driven by commitment to our customers and our desire to make their dreams of homeownership a reality, we offer multiple product lines, including attached and detached entry-level homes and active adult offerings that are marketed and sold under our LGI Homes brand and luxury homes that are marketed and sold under our Terrata Homes brand.

During 2025, our average home completion time was approximately 105 to 135 days, our home size ranged between 900 to approximately 4,000 square feet and our overall sales prices ranged from approximately $192,000 to more than $1,230,000. For the year ended December 31, 2025, we closed 4,788 homes, including 103 currently or previously leased single-family homes. Excluding the 103 currently or previously leased single-family homes, our average sales price per home closed was $364,035. During 2024, our average home completion time was approximately 105 to 135 days, our home size ranged between 900 to approximately 4,100 square feet and our overall sales prices ranged from approximately $191,000 to more than $1,000,000. For the year ended December 31, 2024, we closed 6,131 homes, including the bulk sale of 103 leased single-family homes. Excluding the bulk sale of 103 leased single-family homes, our average sales price per home closed was $365,394.

We pursue a flexible land acquisition strategy of purchasing or optioning finished lots at attractive prices, or purchasing raw land for residential development. Given our successful history as a land developer, we are experienced in converting raw land into residential communities. We endeavor to maintain a pipeline of desirable land positions for replacement and new communities. We generally target land acquisitions that are further away from urban centers than many other suburban communities but have access to major thoroughfares, retail districts and centers of business. Such areas generally result in a better value for the homeowner, either through lower sales prices or larger lot sizes. We consider development opportunities that meet our profit and return objectives, including opportunities that may involve the sale of home sites as a part of the product mix. Projects of interest are typically evaluated at the division level using an extensive due diligence checklist that includes assessing the permitting and regulatory requirements, environmental considerations and local market conditions and evaluating anticipated floor plans, pricing and financial returns. We also determine the number of potential residents in the market and rental households that are within driving distance of the proposed project. We will continue to focus primarily on entry-level homebuyers.

Additionally, we engage in other business activities that leverage or complement our core homebuilding operations. Our wholesale business sells homes primarily to large institutions interested in acquiring single-family rental properties through bulk sales agreements. Beginning in 2021, we began building and leasing a number of single-family homes in select, existing communities. These rental projects are income producing and we maintain the option to sell these homes in a bulk purchase agreement. Finally, from time to time, we enter into strategic joint ventures. We have two equity-method real estate joint ventures and four additional joint ventures engaged primarily to provide services, such as mortgage and insurance, to our homebuyers.

Our well-defined sales and marketing approach focuses on converting renters of apartments and single-family homes into homeowners. We use extensive digital and print advertising to attract potential homebuyers. We employ various marketing methods, such as digital marketing strategies, interactive online media, social media, directional signage, and billboards. These

methods have proven highly successful in reaching our target market, placing potential homebuyers in front of our trained sales professionals and communicating our core messages of value and dream fulfillment.

While a proportion of our business comes from realtors, our marketing efforts are principally designed to connect directly with potential customers currently renting their residences and encourage them to schedule an in-person appointment at one of our information centers. Our information centers are typically open 8 to 10 hours per day, 359 days per year, and are generally staffed by two to four sales professionals.

Our commission-based sales professionals are trained to learn about the current housing situation of the customer, educate them on the value proposition of owning an LGI home, and provide them with a comprehensive understanding of the steps required to achieve homeownership. We also inform customers of our history, vision, and values. Our sales professionals provide floor plans, pricing information, and conduct tours of our homes based on the customer's needs and budget. We provide each customer with a comprehensive introduction to the community and the surrounding area, furnishing them with detailed information regarding utilities, schools, homeowners association dues and restrictions, local entertainment, and nearby dining and shopping options. As a result of our transparent approach, we believe customers receive all the critical information needed to make a buying decision, which we believe sets clear expectations and eliminates confusion during the home buying process.

Our homebuilding operations are organized and managed by seven operating segments: West, Northwest, Central, Midwest, Florida, Southeast and Mid-Atlantic. The Midwest division is included in our Central reportable segment and the Mid-Atlantic division is included in our Southeast reportable segment.

headings: Risk Factors Summary
Industry and Economic Risks
A significant downturn in our housing markets or in the homebuilding industry generally may materially and adversely affect our business and financial condition.
The homebuilding industry is highly competitive and, if our competitors are more successful or offer better value to our customers, our business could decline.
Regional factors affecting the homebuilding industry in our current markets could materially and adversely affect us.
Our industry is cyclical and adverse changes in general and local economic conditions could reduce the demand for homes and, as a result, could have a material adverse effect on us.
Increases in cancellations of purchase contracts could have an adverse effect on our business.
Any limitation on, or reduction or elimination of, tax benefits associated with homeownership would have an adverse effect upon the demand for homes, which could be material to our business.
Fluctuations in real estate values may require us to write-down the book value of our real estate assets.
If the market value of our land inventory decreases, our results of operations could be adversely affected by impairments and write-downs.
Interest rate changes may adversely affect us.
Difficulties with appraisal valuations in relation to the proposed sales price of our homes could force us to reduce the price of our homes for sale.
Any future government shutdowns or slowdowns may materially adversely affect our business or financial results.

Natural disasters, severe weather and adverse geological conditions may increase costs, cause project delays and reduce consumer demand for housing, all of which could materially and adversely affect us.
New and existing laws and regulations or other governmental actions may increase our expenses, limit the number of homes that we can build or delay completion of our projects.

We are subject to environmental, health and safety laws and regulations, which may increase our costs, result in liabilities, limit the areas in which we can build homes and/or delay completion of our projects.
Ownership, leasing or occupation of land and the use of hazardous materials carries potential environmental risks and liabilities.
Inflation could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Changes in tax law could adversely affect our business.
Because of the seasonal nature of our business, our quarterly operating results fluctuate.
Operational and Construction Risks
The long-term sustainability and growth in our home closings depends in part upon our ability to acquire finished lots and land parcels suitable for residential homebuilding at reasonable prices.
Risks associated with our land and lot inventories could adversely affect our business or financial results.

Labor and raw material shortages, price fluctuations and supply chain constraints could delay or increase the cost of home construction or land development, which could materially and adversely affect us.
Our business and results of operations are dependent on the availability, skill and performance of subcontractors.
If we are unable to develop our communities successfully or within expected time-frames, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
We are subject to warranty and liability claims arising in the ordinary course of business that can be significant.
paragraphs: Discussion of our business and operations included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K should be read together with the risk factors set forth below. They describe various risks and uncertainties we are or may become subject to, many of which are difficult to predict or beyond our control. Although the risks summarized below are organized by heading, and each risk is summarized separately, many of the risks are interrelated. These risks and uncertainties, together with other factors described elsewhere in this report, have the potential to affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, strategies or prospects in a material and adverse manner.

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, strategies or prospects. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to, risks related to:
◦Higher mortgage interest rates, and the tightening of mortgage lending standards and mortgage financing requirements;
◦Significant downturn in our housing markets or in the homebuilding industry; ◦The homebuilding industry is highly competitive;
◦New and existing laws and regulations or other governmental actions, including environmental, health and safety laws and regulations;
◦Inflation could adversely affect our business and financial results; ◦The seasonal nature of our business;

paragraphs: The following discussion is intended to assist you in understanding our results of operations and our present financial condition. Our historical consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K contain additional information that should be referred to when reviewing this material. This section covers fiscal years 2025 and 2024 and discusses the results of operations for fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024. The discussion of fiscal year 2023 and the results of operations for fiscal year 2024 compared to fiscal year 2023 is included in Item 7, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" under Part II of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, which was filed with the SEC on February 26, 2025, and is incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K. For purposes of this Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operation, references to "we," "our," "us" or similar terms refer to LGI Homes, Inc. and its subsidiaries.
Key financial results as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025, as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024, were as follows:
•Home sales revenues decreased 22.6% to $1.7 billion from $2.2 billion.
•Homes closed decreased 22.3% to 4,685 homes from 6,028 homes.
•Average sales price per home closed decreased 0.4% to $364,035 from $365,394.
•Gross margin as a percentage of home sales revenues decreased to 20.7% from 24.2%.
•Adjusted gross margin (non-GAAP) as a percentage of home sales revenues decreased to 24.0% from 26.3%.
•Net income before income taxes decreased 62.0% to $98.5 million from $258.9 million.
•Net income decreased 63.0% to $72.6 million from $196.1 million.
•EBITDA (non-GAAP) as a percentage of home sales revenues decreased to 8.7% from 13.8%.
•Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) as a percentage of home sales revenues decreased to 9.1% from 13.8%.
•Active communities at the end of 2025 decreased 4.6% to 144 from 151.
•Total owned and controlled lots decreased 14.2% to 60,842 lots at December 31, 2025 from 70,899 lots at December 31, 2024.
For reconciliations of the non-GAAP financial measures of adjusted gross margin, EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures, please see "—Non-GAAP Measures."

paragraphs: 本公司從事在德克薩斯州、亞利桑那州、佛羅裏達州、喬治亞州、新墨西哥州、科羅拉多州、北卡羅來納州、南卡羅來納州、華盛頓州、田納西州、明尼蘇達州、奧克拉荷馬州、阿拉巴馬州、加州、俄勒岡州、內華達州、西弗吉尼亞州、維吉尼亞州、賓夕法尼亞州、馬裏蘭州及猶他州等市場設計、興建與銷售新住宅。本公司管理階層自1990年代中期以來，一直在住宅土地開發業務領域從事工作。自2003年開始興建住宅業務以來，本公司已興建並完成銷售超過80,000棟住宅。
LGI Homes, Inc. 為一間於2013年7月9日成立的特拉華州公司。本公司主要營運總部位於1450 Lake Robbins Drive, Suite 430, The Woodlands, Texas 77380，電話號碼為(281) 362-8998。本網站或連結至本網站之資訊，除非明確標註，否則不視為本10-K年報之參考資料。
除非另有說明或語境需要，「LGI」、「本公司」、「我們」、「我們的」及「我們」均指LGI Homes, Inc.及其子公司。
自2013年12月起，本公司已大幅成長，將業務從四州的八個市場擴展至21州的36個市場。截至2025年12月31日，本公司於美國各地共活躍於144個社區，並預期未來持續增加社區數量。
基於對客戶的承諾及實現客戶成為屋主夢想的願景，本公司提供多種產品線，包括附屬與獨立式入門住宅及活躍成人住宅，這些住宅均以LGI Homes品牌行銷與銷售，並提供高檔住宅，以Terrata Homes品牌行銷與銷售。

2025年，本公司平均住宅完工時間為約105至135天，住宅面積範圍為900至約4,000平方英呎，整體銷售價格範圍為約192,000美元至超過1,230,000美元。截至2025年12月31日，本公司完成銷售4,788棟住宅，包括103棟目前或先前租賃的單戶住宅。扣除這103棟目前或先前租賃的單戶住宅後，本公司每棟住宅的平均銷售價格為364,035美元。2024年，本公司平均住宅完工時間為約105至135天，住宅面積範圍為900至約4,100平方英呎，整體銷售價格範圍為約191,000美元至超過1,000,000美元。截至2024年12月31日，本公司完成銷售6,131棟住宅，包括103棟租賃單戶住宅的批量銷售。扣除這103棟租賃單戶住宅的批量銷售後，本公司每棟住宅的平均銷售價格為365,394美元。

本公司採用靈活的土地取得策略，以有吸引力的價格購買或取得完工土地，或購買未開發土地以進行住宅開發。基於本公司在土地開發方面的成功經驗，我們擅長將未開發土地轉化為住宅社區。我們致力於維持一個具吸引力的土地庫存，以供替換及新社區使用。我們通常會尋找距離都市中心較遠但擁有主要道路、零售區及商業中心的地區進行土地取得，這些地區通常能為屋主帶來更高的價值，無論是透過較低的銷售價格或較大的土地面積。我們會評估符合我們利潤及回報目標的開發機會，包括可能涉及銷售住宅用地作為產品組合一部分的機會。對我們而言，有興趣的項目通常會在分公司層級進行評估，使用一項廣泛的盡職調查清單，包括評估許可證及法規要求、環境考量及當地市場條件，並評估預期的樓層設計、價格及財務回報。我們也會評估市場中潛在居民數量及位於擬建項目車程範圍內的租賃家庭數量。我們將持續主要著力於入門住宅買家。

此外，本公司從事其他業務活動，這些活動能支援或補強我們的核心住宅興建業務。我們的批發業務主要向大型機構銷售住宅，這些機構對透過批量銷售協議取得單戶出租住宅感興趣。自2021年起，我們開始在部分現有社區興建並租賃數棟單戶住宅。這些出租項目具有收入產生能力，我們保留透過批量購買協議出售這些住宅的選擇權。最後，有時我們會進行戰略性合資企業。我們擁有兩間權益法實務的房地產合資企業，以及四間其他主要提供房貸及保險等服務給我們住宅買家的合資企業。
本公司明確的銷售與行銷策略著重於將租賃公寓及單戶住宅的租客轉化為房東。我們透過廣泛的數位與印刷廣告來吸引潛在購屋者。我們運用多種行銷方法，例如數位行銷策略、互動線上媒體、社交媒體、導向標誌及廣告看板。這些
方法已證實在接觸我們目標市場上非常成功，將潛在購屋者介紹給我們受過訓練的銷售專業人員，並傳達我們核心價值觀與實現夢想的訊息。
雖然我們業務的一部分來自於房仲，但我們的行銷努力主要是設計用來直接與目前租賃住宅的潛在客戶接觸，並鼓勵他們預約至我們資訊中心進行親自會面。我們的資訊中心通常每天開放 8 到 10 小時，全年無休 359 天，並通常由兩到四名銷售專業人員支援。

我們的佣金制銷售專業人員受過訓練，以瞭解客戶當前的住房情況，教育他們擁有 LGI 住宅的價值主張，並提供他們實現房東夢想所需的步驟的全面理解。我們也向客戶說明我們的歷史、願景與價值觀。我們的銷售專業人員會提供樓層規劃、價格資訊，並根據客戶的需求與預算進行住宅導覽。我們為每位客戶提供社區與周邊地區的全面介紹，提供有關電力、學校、房東協會費用與限制、當地娛樂設施及附近餐飲與購物選項的詳細資訊。由於我們透明的作法，我們相信客戶能獲得做出購屋決定所需的關鍵資訊，這使我們相信能明確設定期待，並在購屋過程中消除混淆。
我們的住宅建造業務由七個運營分部組織與管理：西區、西北區、中部、中西部、佛羅裏達州、東南區及中大西洋區。中西部分部包含在我們的中部應報告分部內，而中大西洋分部則包含在我們的東南區應報告分部內。

paragraphs: 以下討論旨在協助您瞭解我們的營運成果與目前財務狀況。我們的歷史合併財務報表及附註說明，包含於本年度報表 10-K 其他部分，審閱此資料時應參考這些資訊。本節涵蓋財務年度 2025 年及 2024 年，並討論 2025 年財務年度營運成果與 2024 年財務年度的比較。2023 年財務年度的討論以及 2024 年財務年度營運成果與 2023 年財務年度的比較，包含於本年度報表 10-K 第二部分「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」項目 7，該項目為 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度之年度報表，於 2025 年 2 月 26 日提交至 SEC，並已納入本年度報表 10-K。為本「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」之目的，提及「我們」、「我們的」、「我們」或類似詞彙，均指 LGI Homes, Inc. 及其子公司。
截至及截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度比較之關鍵財務結果如下：
•住宅銷售收入減少 22.6% 至 1.7 十億美元，較 2.2 十億美元。
•已完工住宅數量減少 22.3% 至 4,685 棟住宅，較 6,028 棟住宅。
•每棟已完工住宅平均銷售價格減少 0.4% 至 364,035 美元，較 365,394 美元。
•住宅銷售收入之毛利率百分比減少至 20.7%，較 24.2%。
•調整後毛利率（非 GAAP）佔住宅銷售收入百分比減少至 24.0%，較 26.3%。
•稅前淨收入減少 62.0% 至 98.5 百萬美元，較 258.9 百萬美元。
•EBITDA（非GAAP）佔住宅銷售收入百分比降至8.7% ，較13.8%。
•調整後EBITDA（非GAAP）佔住宅銷售收入百分比降至9.1% ，較13.8%。
•總擁有及控制的地段數減少14.2% 至60,842 個地段於2025年12月31日，較2024年12月31日的70,899 個地段。
為瞭解非GAAP財務指標調整毛利、EBITDA及調整後EBITDA與最直接可比的GAAP財務指標的調整關係，請參閱『—非GAAP指標。』

headings: 風險因素總覽
產業與經濟風險
若我方住宅市場或整體住宅建設產業出現顯著衰退，可能會對我方業務與財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。
住宅建設產業競爭激烈，若我方競爭對手更為成功或能為客戶提供更優質的價值，我方業務可能會下滑。
影響我方現有市場住宅建設產業的區域性因素，可能會對我方造成重大且不利的影響。
我方產業具有週期性，若總體與地方經濟條件出現不利變化，可能會降低住宅需求，進而對我方造成重大不利影響。
購屋合約取消數量增加，可能會對我方業務造成不利影響。
任何對住宅所有權稅務優惠的限制、減少或取消，都可能影響住宅需求，進而對我方業務造成重大影響。
不動產價值波動可能導致我們必須減記不動產資產的帳面價值。
若我們的土地存貨市價下降，可能對我們的營運結果造成不利影響，包括減損與減記。
利率變動可能對我們造成不利影響。
與我們住宅銷售價格相關的評估價值困難，可能迫使我們降低待售住宅的價格。
任何未來政府停擺或運作減緩，可能對我們的業務或財務結果造成重大不利影響。
天然災害、嚴峻天氣及不利地質條件可能增加成本、導致專案延誤，並降低消費者對住宅的需求，所有這些情況都可能對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
新舊法規或政府其他措施，可能增加我們的費用、限制我們可興建住宅的數量，或延遲專案完工。
我們受環境、健康與安全法規的約束，這些法規可能增加我們的成本、導致我們產生責任、限制我們可興建住宅的區域，並/或延遲專案完工。
Ownership, leasing or occupation of land and the use of hazardous materials carries potential environmental risks and liabilities.
Inflation could adversely affect our business and financial results.
Changes in tax law could adversely affect our business.
Because of the seasonal nature of our business, our quarterly operating results fluctuate.
Operational and Construction Risks
The long-term sustainability and growth in our home closings depends in part upon our ability to acquire finished lots and land parcels suitable for residential homebuilding at reasonable prices.
Risks associated with our land and lot inventories could adversely affect our business or financial results.

Labor and raw material shortages, price fluctuations and supply chain constraints could delay or increase the cost of home construction or land development, which could materially and adversely affect us.
本公司營運及營業成果依賴 subcontractors 之可得性、專業技能與表現。
若本公司無法成功發展社區或在預期時間內完成，將可能對營業成果產生不利影響。
本公司因正常營運過程而產生之保固及責任索賠，可能具有重大影響。
paragraphs: 本年報 10-K 所包含的業務與營運說明應與下列風險因素一併閱讀。這些風險因素說明了我們或可能面臨的各種風險與不確定性，其中許多難以預測或超出我們的控制範圍。雖然下列風險因素是以標題分類，並分別總結，但許多風險因素是相互關聯的。這些風險與不確定性，加上本報告其他部分所提及的其他因素，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、策略或前景造成重大且不利的影響。
我們的業務面臨許多風險，包括可能使我們無法達成業務目標，或對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、策略或前景造成不利影響的風險。這些風險在下文中會更詳細地討論，包括但不限於以下風險：
◦房貸利率上升，以及房貸貸款標準與房貸融資要求的趨嚴；
◦我們的住宅市場或住宅建築業出現顯著衰退；◦住宅建築業競爭激烈；
◦新的及現行的法律與法規或其他政府措施，包括環境、健康與安全法規；
◦通貨膨脹可能對我們的業務與財務結果造成不利影響；◦我們業務的季節性特質；
